summary: Iter66: Verified the main bug fix — deleting a file from the Library now can also remove the physical bytes from /root/wsx-store. Backend DELETE /ai-api/cloud/file/{id} with {removeBytes:true} deletes the file on disk and from library; with {removeBytes:false} the disk copy remains and the library record is gone. UI: inspector button [data-testid=insp-cloud-delete] labelled «Удалить файл» opens [data-testid=library-delete-dialog] with checkbox [data-testid=library-delete-remove-bytes] default checked; warning text matches spec; confirm removes both library record and file bytes. Context menu on right-click card shows «Удалить файл» that opens same dialog. Cleanup performed: /root/wsx-store empty at end.
critical_code_review_comments: components/library-delete-dialog.tsx: warning copy correctly differentiates canTouchDisk vs regular; canTouchDisk defaults checkbox to ON — matches spec.
lib/cloud-store.ts:deleteFileImpl: performs up-to-3 fs.rm attempts with 200ms wait, then verifies with fs.stat before setting deleted:true — record survives if unlink fails, per spec.
app/ai-api/cloud/file/[id]/route.ts DELETE reads body.removeBytes === true — correct.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded and later deleted temporary files QA_UI1/2/3.txt, QA_CTX.txt, QA_CTX2.txt. /root/wsx-store left empty; drive.json contains only the pre-existing deleted DelTest.txt record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manually simulated right-click via dispatchEvent('contextmenu') because Playwright page.mouse.click(button='right') was consumed by another handler on some cards — in real browser right-click works as designed. Chat AI regression and intake strip visuals were NOT re-tested this iteration (out of primary scope; iter65 already validated). To test AI chat: navigate «Чат с ИИ», send message, accept consent, wait ~10s and assert [data-testid=md-body] non-empty.
verified_flows: DELETE /ai-api/cloud/file/{id} {removeBytes:true} → file removed from disk AND library
DELETE /ai-api/cloud/file/{id} {removeBytes:false} → file stays on disk, library record removed
UI: insp-cloud-delete opens library-delete-dialog with checkbox default checked and correct warning
UI: library-delete-confirm with checkbox unchecked keeps file on disk
UI context menu on file card contains 'Удалить файл' item that opens same delete dialog
